name: RNAtomy
description: Self-supervised RNA foundation model pretrained on about 200K RNAs from RNAcentral by joint masked reconstruction of a pairwise geometry tensor and a residue-wise descriptor matrix (23 features per nucleotide), with a hybrid Mamba-Transformer backbone.

attributes.access: Code on GitHub; weights (rnatomy.pth), sequences and descriptors on Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.23968854; complete 2D maps (about 130 GB) available on request
